title: Join us: Building Secure Healthcare Systems
partialText: Register for our July 30 panel on reducing risk through better architecture, AI governance, and developer workflows, featuring David Pace of Merck and Joël Quenneville and Clarissa Borges of thoughtbot.

title: Upcase has retired, but the learning continues
partialText: We've retired Upcase, but our commitment to sharing what we learn hasn't changed. Here's where you can continue learning with us through articles, videos, podcasts, and more.
